name: Complete REST CRUD Resource — Product Store & Router
description: Implement Product types, ProductStore in-memory repository, and HTTP router for full CRUD lifecycle.

inputs.task_prompt: Build a complete Product CRUD resource: 1) Define Product { id: string, name: string, price: number, inStock: boolean } and DTOs in src/types.ts. 2) Implement ProductStore in src/store.ts with create, get, list(filter?: { inStock?: boolean }), update, delete. 3) Implement handleRequest in src/router.ts supporting GET /products, GET /products/:id, POST /products, PATCH /products/:id, DELETE /products/:id. Ensure test/crud.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: src/store.ts ProductStore implements CRUD and filtering
src/router.ts handleRequest handles HTTP methods, status codes (200, 201, 204, 404), and JSON bodies
constraints: handleRequest must return { status: number, body?: any }
